Fresh Slice Pizza – Marketing Campaign


STPPositioningSocial



Analyzed target segments (students, professionals, commuters) around Broadway City Hall station.


Built content + offer plan (IG/TikTok short videos, UGC “slice-of-the-day”, QR coupons at station exits).


Positioned affordability, convenience, and lighter choices vs. Uncle Faith’s; proposed Vegan Mania angle.


Deliverables: campaign deck, execution checklist, 600-word action memo with 5 caption variants.







AWS Cloud Portfolio


Quarto docs for IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, Governance — hosted on GitHub Pages. 



Built VPC with public/private subnets, route tables, IGW/NAT; hardened security groups.


Configured IAM roles/policies; S3 with versioning, replication, lifecycle and encryption.


Documented each module with diagrams & screenshots and hosted the Quarto site on GitHub Pages.



View on GitHub





Predictive Analytics – Hotel Booking Demand


ABT DesignDecision TreesKNNRegression



Goal: Predict cancellation risk & inform overbooking thresholds.


ABT: Feature engineering for lead time, seasonality, customer type, LOS; leakage checks.


Models: DT & KNN for classification; MLR for LOS/ADR; train/test split with cross-validation.


Metrics: Accuracy & F1 for cancellations; MAE/RMSE for regression.


Outcome: Thresholds for high-risk bookings; recommendation memo + comparison table.
